$comment: Internal draft. Public sanitized copy: factorforge-cds/docs/validationhub/intake_schema_v0.1.public.json. IMPORTANT: public unsalted sequence_hash is prohibited in intake records (see prohibited_fields.json conditionally_prohibited_field_names). Internal salted/HMAC fingerprints in private pipelines are allowed. Use design_package_id as the public linkage key. design_package.json/evidence.sequence_hash is allowed — that is a different context (internal artifact, not intake record).
title: ValidationHub Computational Intake Record v0.1
description: Internal schema for FactorForge computational validation records. Separates computational results from experimental outcomes. Does not collect raw sequences or identifiers.

schema_version.$comment: Bump when any required field is added/removed/renamed. See docs/SCHEMA_VERSIONING.md.

design_package_id.$comment: The design_id from the corresponding FactorForge Design Package (design_package.json). This is the primary link between the intake record and the computational artifact. Do not use sequence_hash here (prohibited).

sequence_publication_source.$comment: Citation for the public amino-acid sequence used as optimizer input. For the sfGFP worked example: 'Pédelacq et al. 2006, Nat Biotechnol 24:79-88, PMID 16369541'. Not required for benchmark_reference records.

public_example_id.$comment: Stable identifier for a publicly documented example run. Format: {protein}_{profile}_seed{seed}_{host}_v{n}.

host_organism.$comment: Full scientific or common name. e.g., 'Nicotiana benthamiana'. Must match the host_profile used in the Design Package.

evidence_type.$comment: Discriminator field. computational_validation = optimizer output only. wetlab_observation = experimental result exists. benchmark_reference = record derived from formal benchmark run.

computational.$comment: Scoring contract v1.1 fields. gc_in_target_range and multi_constraint_pass are the key fields for linking to benchmark evidence. gc_min=55.0, gc_max=65.0 for N. benthamiana.

scoring_contract_version.$comment: Current: 'v1.1'. v1.0 omitted gc_in_target_range from multi_constraint_pass — do not use v1.0 records without recomputing with canonical_multi_constraint_pass().

gc_in_target_range.$comment: Primitive: computed as gc_min <= gc_percent <= gc_max. For N. benthamiana: 55.0 <= gc_percent <= 65.0. Never derived from multi_constraint_pass.

multi_constraint_pass.$comment: Derived field: biological_pass AND assembly_pass AND gc_in_target_range (scoring_contract v1.1). MUST NOT be asserted manually. Always computed from the three primitives.

multi_constraint_pass_definition.$comment: Canonical 3-primitive definition string (scoring_contract v1.1). const enforces exact match. Changing this requires a scoring_contract version bump. Expanded 5-primitive form: aa_identity==1.0 AND internal_stop_count==0 AND invalid_codon_count==0 AND gc_in_target_range==true AND forbidden_type_iis_site_count==0 (where biological_pass = aa_identity==1.0 AND internal_stop_count==0 AND invalid_codon_count==0; assembly_pass = forbidden_type_iis_site_count==0).

experimental.$comment: Wet-lab outcome section. For computational-only records, outcome_status should be 'not_tested'. This section is optional in v0.1; will become required in future versions when wet-lab feedback is collected.

outcome_status.$comment: not_tested = no wet-lab performed. pass = expression confirmed. fail = no expression. partial = expression below threshold or ambiguous.
